mappings.Name: Single source of truth — no duplicate warehouses serving the same purpose
mappings.ScoringLogic: 0=Fail (3+ databases match warehouse naming patterns with significant object counts), 1=Partial Pass (2 potential duplicates detected), 2=Mostly Pass (1 primary warehouse detected or 0 detected due to non-standard naming). Capped at 2 per partial-evidence rule since true "purpose" validation requires human review.

mappings.Name: Environment separation exists (Dev / Test / Prod) with isolated instances or databases
mappings.ScoringLogic: 0 = No environment indicators found in server/instance name or database names. 1 = Partial evidence (database names contain environment keywords, but server name does not). 2 = Strong evidence (Server/Instance name clearly indicates a specific environment, suggesting isolated instance). Max score capped at 2 as full compliance requires architectural/human verification.

mappings.Name: Server/database topology documented (instances, databases, elastic pools)
mappings.ScoringLogic: 0 = Fail (Cannot enumerate topology or critical system views are inaccessible), 1 = Partial Pass (Topology successfully enumerated but no internal documentation artifacts found), 2 = Mostly Pass (Topology fully enumerated with extended properties/metadata present, serving as an automated documentation baseline. Max score capped at 2 per partial-evidence rule.)
